identity_locks.Sylvain: Academy-era Sylvain: handsome red-haired noble student, relaxed smile with tired clever eyes, Blue Lions academy uniform worn slightly casually, charming but not oily, never modern playboy.
identity_locks.Mercedes: Academy-era Mercedes: gentle young blonde healer, soft refined face, side-swept bangs, black-gold hair ribbon, white high collar, blue-black Blue Lions uniform with beige shoulder detail, warm sisterly presence, never nun-like elderly.

dialogue.speaker: Sylvain
dialogue.text: All right. What is something you like?

dialogue.speaker: Mercedes
dialogue.text: I like to pray. I have prayed regularly since I was a child.

dialogue.speaker: Sylvain
dialogue.text: You grew up in the Empire, didn't you? In a church?

dialogue.speaker: Mercedes
dialogue.text: Yes, and-- Oh! Praying. I forgot I was on my way to pray.

bridge_actions.text: Mercedes looks down at the prayer book.
Sylvain follows her gaze, realizing he interrupted.
